# An Asset hybrid picture transmits only its Entity and assigned Tasks

<!-- Generated by tests/e2e. Regenerate with ATLAS_E2E_UPDATE=1; review every change. -->

## 1. Enroll Alpha

SDK `GET /dataset` with <enrollment key>

→ **200**
```json
{
  "id": "<id-1>",
  "writing_release": "0.1.0"
}
```

SDK `POST /entities` with <enrollment key>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "id": "<alpha>",
  "request_id": "<alpha request>",
  "kind": "asset",
  "credential": "<alpha credential>",
  "alias": "Alpha",
  "command_manifest": [
    {
      "command_id": "move_to",
      "scheduling": [
        "queued"
      ],
      "cancellation": true,
      "progress": true
    }
  ]
}
```

→ **201**
```json
{
  "asset": {
    "alias": "Alpha",
    "change_sequence": 1,
    "command_manifest": [
      {
        "cancellation": true,
        "command_id": "move_to",
        "progress": true,
        "scheduling": [
          "queued"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "components": {
      "communications": {
        "link_state": "offline"
      },
      "heartbeat": {
        "last_seen": null
      },
      "status": {
        "reported_at": null,
        "value": "unknown"
      }
    },
    "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
    "id": "<alpha>",
    "kind": "asset",
    "subtype": null,
    "version": 1
  },
  "credential_id": "<id-2>",
  "principal_id": "<id-3>"
}
```

## 5. Create one Task for each Asset

SDK `GET /dataset` with <operator key>

→ **200**
```json
{
  "id": "<id-1>",
  "writing_release": "0.1.0"
}
```

SDK `GET /dataset` with <operator key>

→ **200**
```json
{
  "id": "<id-1>",
  "writing_release": "0.1.0"
}
```

SDK `POST /tasks` with <operator key>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "submission_id": "<own submission>",
  "asset_id": "<alpha>",
  "command_id": "move_to",
  "input": {
    "latitude": 40,
    "longitude": -70
  },
  "scheduling": "queued"
}
```

→ **201**
```json
{
  "acceptance_sequence": 1,
  "asset_id": "<alpha>",
  "change_sequence": 3,
  "command_id": "move_to",
  "created_sequence": 3,
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "id": "<own Task>",
  "input": {
    "latitude": 40,
    "longitude": -70
  },
  "scheduling": "queued",
  "status": "pending",
  "submission_id": "<own submission>",
  "version": 1
}
```

SDK `POST /tasks` with <operator key>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "submission_id": "<unrelated submission>",
  "asset_id": "<beta>",
  "command_id": "move_to",
  "input": {
    "latitude": 41,
    "longitude": -71
  },
  "scheduling": "queued"
}
```

→ **201**
```json
{
  "acceptance_sequence": 1,
  "asset_id": "<beta>",
  "change_sequence": 4,
  "command_id": "move_to",
  "created_sequence": 4,
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "id": "<unrelated Task>",
  "input": {
    "latitude": 41,
    "longitude": -71
  },
  "scheduling": "queued",
  "status": "pending",
  "submission_id": "<unrelated submission>",
  "version": 1
}
```

```json
{
  "local": 1,
  "full": 2
}
```

## 7. Cancellation intent and the later outcome remain in scope

SDK `PATCH /tasks/<own Task>/status` with <operator key>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "status": "cancellation_requested",
  "request_id": "<cancellation request>"
}
```

→ **200**
```json
{
  "acceptance_sequence": 1,
  "asset_id": "<alpha>",
  "cancellation_request_id": "<cancellation request>",
  "change_sequence": 5,
  "command_id": "move_to",
  "created_sequence": 3,
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "id": "<own Task>",
  "input": {
    "latitude": 40,
    "longitude": -70
  },
  "scheduling": "queued",
  "status": "cancellation_requested",
  "submission_id": "<own submission>",
  "version": 2
}
```

direct `PATCH /tasks/<own Task>/status` with <alpha credential>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "report_id": "<completion report>",
  "sequence": 1,
  "status": "completed"
}
```

→ **200**
```json
{
  "acceptance_sequence": 1,
  "asset_id": "<alpha>",
  "cancellation_request_id": "<cancellation request>",
  "change_sequence": 7,
  "command_id": "move_to",
  "created_sequence": 3,
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "id": "<own Task>",
  "input": {
    "latitude": 40,
    "longitude": -70
  },
  "scheduling": "queued",
  "status": "completed",
  "submission_id": "<own submission>",

}
```

## 9. Scope credentials and cursors cannot cross identities

direct `GET /queries/full?scope=asset` with <operator key>

→ **403**
```json
{
  "code": "forbidden",
  "message": "This credential may not call this operation."
}
```

direct `GET /queries/changed-since?scope=asset&cursor=<cursor-1>` with <beta credential>

→ **400**
```json
{
  "code": "invalid_cursor",
  "message": "The cursor is not valid for this list."
}
```

direct `GET /queries/changed-since?cursor=<cursor-1>` with <alpha credential>

→ **400**
```json
{
  "code": "invalid_cursor",
  "message": "The cursor is not valid for this list."
}
```
